Welcome to the Neuroscience & Behavior Program
The Neuroscience and Behavior (NSB) Graduate Program at UMass Amherst is one of eight Graduate Programs in the Life Sciences and part of a larger Neurosciences community at the University. NSB brings together faculty members from various departments to provide exciting, cutting-edge research training. The program spans several areas of research including: Neuroendocrinology, Cellular and Molecular Neuroscience, Animal Behavior and Learning, Neural and Behavioral Development, and Sensorimotor, Cognitive, and Computational Neuroscience.
Find out more about the Initiative on Neurosciences (IONs) here.
Follow the NSB program on Instagram and Neurosciences at UMass on Facebook.
